text_block_list.text:
The intense race is over, and Winning
Ticket,
having been unable to achieve
victory, shows her
frustration.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On top of that, she is worried about the
mounting
threat of Нарита Таисин and
her fierce sprinting
ability.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Shaking off her uneasiness, Ticket forces
herself
to focus squarely on the
Japanese Derby, where
she can't afford
to lose.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
